items.title: Canada added 54,000 jobs in November as unemployment rate falls
items.description: Canada's national unemployment rate fell 0.4 per cent in November to 6.5 per cent, and marks the second straight monthly decline in the unemployment rate.

items.title: Quebec losing $1.5B a year as anglophones face high unemployment, lower wages: report
items.description: A new report finds anglophones face higher unemployment and lower wages in Quebec; gaps that researchers say carry major economic consequences.

items.title: Industry experts question Saab's pitch to bring 10,000 jobs to Canada
items.description: Critics are questioning the solidity of Saab's pitch to deliver 10,000 jobs in Canada if it decides to set up shop here to assemble Gripen fighter jets.

items.title: Canada's Summer McIntosh wins 400M freestyle by more than 15 seconds at U.S. Open swim meet
items.description: Canada's Summer McIntosh set a new U.S. Open record in the women's 400-metre freestyle on Thursday night at the Toyota U.S. Open Championships.

items.title: Long-awaited electronic medical records system to launch Saturday at IWK Health Centre
items.description: If all goes according to plan, at 6 a.m. AT on Saturday people working at the IWK Health Centre will become the test case for a generational change to Nova Scotia’s health-care system.

items.title: Manitoba Government Signs onto National Electricity Grid Memorandum of Understanding
Newfoundland girl’s disappearance prompts calls for tougher laws to stop abductions
items.description: The girl’s disappearance underscores long-standing concerns about the ease with which a parent can take a child to another country without the other parent’s knowledge or consent.

items.title: What happens to the wood from this burnt forest?
items.description: The cleanup of the Long Lake wildfire in Nova Scotia’s Annapolis County has begun. So what happens to the thousands of hectares of forest that was burned? The CBC’s Aly Thomson went to West Dalhousie to find out.

items.title: TTC maintenance, asbestos cleanup delaying parts of Rogers' 5G subway network build
items.description: Asbestos cleanup, tight work windows and other TTC delays have slowed the build out of 5G cellular service in Toronto's subway system.

items.title: A fresh take on Little Women at Granville Island Stage
items.description: A multi-generational fave returns with a refreshed and theatrical approach.

items.title: Sinéad X Sanders on traumatic brain injuries, cognitive dissonance, and a long-awaited killer debut
items.description: Vancouver finest players rally around a singer with an extraordinary story.
